title: Remove obsolete py3.9 required check from ruleset
description: Update GitHub ruleset so branch protection no longer requires Python 3.9 quality-check status.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Updated GitHub repository ruleset `main-branch-protection` (id: 13256380) to remove obsolete required status check `Quality Checks (Python 3.9)`. Remaining required checks: Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12 quality checks plus `Test VSCode Extension`. Verified via `gh api repos/AnthusAI/Tactus/rulesets/13256380`.
